name: IRCoT
original_settings: BM25; at most 8 reasoning steps and 15 collected paragraphs. Retrieval cutoff selected from 2, 4, 6, or 8. Evaluation uses 500 sampled questions per benchmark and 3 demonstration sets; MuSiQue results cover the 2-hop subset.

name: ReAct
original_settings: 6 HotpotQA demonstrations; Wikipedia Search, Lookup, and Finish actions. The reported result uses PaLM-540B.

name: Self-Ask
original_settings: Search-engine answers are inserted into follow-up QA. Evaluation uses 1,200 2WikiQA questions and 1,252 MuSiQue 2-hop questions.

name: GenGround
original_settings: ColBERTv2 retrieves 10 documents; grounding uses batches of 3. Main results use gpt-3.5-turbo at temperature 0 on 1,400 sampled questions per benchmark; distillation trains Mistral-7B on 50,000 synthetic examples. Reported metrics are containment-based Cover-EM and F1.

name: DEC
original_settings: E5-base retrieves 10 candidates; DEC selects 2 plus keyword-matching documents. The keyword extractor is LoRA-tuned Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. Evaluation samples 500 questions per benchmark. Reported metrics are containment-based Cover-EM and F1.

name: DeepRAG
original_settings: BM25 over the DPR Wikipedia passage collection. Imitation learning uses 4,000 examples from each of HotpotQA and 2WikiQA; calibration uses an additional 1,000 per dataset. Online calibration sets the retrieval budget to 5.

name: R-Search
original_settings: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in the matched-backbone comparison. GRPO in TRL 0.18.0 trains on 1,000 generated QA pairs. Search uses arXiv, GNews, and Serper; training retrieves 2 passages per query and samples 4 rollouts.

name: CoA
original_settings: Sentence-preserving chunks fit each worker's context budget; workers communicate sequentially before manager synthesis. LongBench QA evaluation uses text-bison@001, text-unicorn@001, and Gemini Ultra with an 8K context window per agent.

name: GeAR
original_settings: BM25--SBERT hybrid retrieval; all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings. Graph beam length 2, width 10, and 100 neighbors per beam. Maximum iterations: 2 for HotpotQA/2WikiQA and 4 for MuSiQue. Final QA uses 5 passages; temperature 0.

name: BELLE
original_settings: BM25 over October 2017 Wikipedia; 3--10 candidate documents. Five operator types; affirmative, negative, fast, slow, and judge roles. Meta prompts allow at most 3 debate rounds. GPT-3.5-turbo uses Azure API version 2024-01-25. Reported EM uses answer containment; MuSiQue F1 is reported for 2-, 3-, and 4-hop questions (50.50, 42.10, and 29.20).

name: PER
original_settings: PER-QA retrieves 100 BM25 candidates, reranks with E5-base, and retains 5 from December 2018 Wikipedia. The planner uses GPT-4o and the executor/reasoner use Llama3.1-8B-Instruct. PER-DP preprocessing retains 2,218 HotpotQA, 1,972 MuSiQue, and 4,204 2WikiQA evaluation samples.
